fields.label: Features
fields.description: Switch a feature off to stop it without uninstalling the app. Existing records are kept.

fields.label: Enable CrossChex Cloud Integration
fields.description: Scheduled punch sync, reconciliation, token refresh and the webhook. Crosschex Settings still has its own sync and webhook switches.

fields.label: Enable Shift Scheduling
fields.description: Submitting a Schedule, the daily generation job and regeneration after a Shift change.

fields.label: Enable Flexible Timetables and Break Deduction
fields.description: When off, auto attendance uses standard HRMS rules for every Shift Type and the Timetable Mode / Break Period fields are hidden.

fields.label: Show Punch Summary on Employee Checkin
fields.description: Table of the same day's punches on the Employee Checkin form.

fields.label: Flexible Shift & Overtime
fields.description: Day-start flexible shifts, OT1 / OT2 on Attendance, and attendance from punches on holidays.
